scripts.installer: vite build && node build-pkg.js && iscc tagflix-installer.iss
scripts.cap:init: npx cap init tagflix com.tagflix.app --web-dir dist
scripts.cap:build: vite build && npx cap sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:build: vite build && node -e "const f=require('fs'),p='dist/index.html';f.writeFileSync(p,f.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace(/ crossorigin/g,''))" && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: vite build && node -e "const f=require('fs'),p='dist/index.html';f.writeFileSync(p,f.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace(/ crossorigin/g,''))" && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
